technical.summary: EPAM shows bullish short-term momentum with strong volume and price action confirmation (three white soldiers, hull flip, CMF cross), but lacks trend strength (low ADX) and intermediate-term support (below EMA50/200), making this a moderate-probability swing entry suitable for tight risk management.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day creates elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional selling by senior Republicans and weak AAII sentiment (59% bearish) create conflicting signals; lack of news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (397.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, FOMC event today, and earnings in 1 day create a perfect storm of macro and binary event risks for EPAM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical momentum (three white soldiers, hull flip, volume spike 15x, EMA golden cross, CMF cross) with contrarian extreme fear opportunity presents tactical swing entry if risk is tightly managed.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 1 day combined with VIX crisis regime (397.6), macro headwinds (rising dollar, FOMC today, flat yield curve), and price below both EMA50/200 with weak trend strength (ADX false) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — moderate entry quality between support 287.02 and resistance 306.11, but proximity to earnings event negates positional advantage

decision.entry_rationale: While EPAM displays strong short-term technical momentum (three white soldiers, hull flip, 15x volume spike, golden cross), the combination of earnings binary event in 1 day and VIX crisis regime (397.6) creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for a swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 1 day will trigger binary volatility that negates technical setup; macro headwinds (FOMC today, rising dollar, flat yield curve) amplify downside risk in crisis VIX environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; only sentiment offers contrarian opportunity insufficient to override binary event risk
decision.portfolio_note: Already 9 positions in Information Technology sector; adding EPAM increases concentration risk without fundamental or macro justification.
